title: Local Values and References
scenario: Local values name expressions so they can be reused without turning them into input variables. Declare the project name and derive a bucket name from it.
constraints: Use references rather than repeating the literal value.

focus.title: Add the local values
focus.todo: Define project and derive bucket_name with an interpolation.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `locals`. Define project and derive bucket_name with an interpolation. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `locals`. Use this code shape: project; bucket_name. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `local.project`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
